# IBP Solver core

Unmodified core headers from https://github.com/modulargraph/ibp-solver, commit `574c5bd3a0140a141515facafb44b563727efd4f`. Licensed under GPL-3.0; see LICENSE.

This pinned source snapshot lets DiffExp build offline. The integration uses the public `Geometry`, `generate`, `Field` and `Solver` interfaces. Update all three headers together from an audited upstream commit. GPU batch replay remains in the standalone package; this adapter supplies individual multivariate reconstruction probes.
